svg.text: Drawn by tools/render_previews.py from the parts the real WorldVisuals, TycoonCore and ShopServer code build (boxes seen from above, flat colors).
Up the page is +Z, the way the plots face and the default camera looks. Only Studio shows the real look.
spawn plaza, around the SpawnLocation (Studio fact)
Paving and streets: light gray and sand. Kerbs: white. Lawns: green tints. Trees and bushes: round greens. Lamps: dark squares
The whole Baseplate (2048 x 2048, Studio fact) with the far hills
Red frame: the big map above. Green circles: the six low hills (sunk spheres, seen where they meet the ground).
Dashed gray: the Studio-only preview rooms (PREVIEW_STAGES), which the world keeps out of.
The plots, their signs, the lounge and the spawn pad are the game's own objects, drawn where the real code puts them.
